messages:
Maya: Heads up — starting a 'lightswitch' canary for v3.2.1 in ~5m. Initial cut: 5% global traffic. Change window 22:00-23:30. tagging @Oliver @Jess for ops/quality.

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated: lightswitch-canary v3.2.1 -> id=cny-3151. Rolling to 5% target.

Oliver: Watching latency/5xx. I'll keep an eye on eu-west especially.

Jess: Running quick smoke eval with promptset 'smoke-chat' now. Will post results in ~3m.

Tom: Quick rule-of-thumb for stop criteria: 95p latency +100ms over baseline OR 5xx > 0.5% sustained for 10m => hold/rollback.

Kai: Noted. Last time we saw KV cache churn with batching changes. Watching kvcache.evictions and GPU mem.

sre-bot: Metric alert (automated): eu-west 95p latency +8% over baseline for the last 3m. CPU/GPU pressure: node-gpu-12 memory usage 92%.

Maya: Hmm — can we hold traffic while infra confirms the memory bump? @Oliver any preference (pin vs regional hold)?

Oliver: Hold at 5% for a moment. If it's isolated to eu-west we should route eu-west to baseline model and continue global canary. Prefer not to rollback global yet.

Jess: Smoke eval partial results: 50 samples -> 47/50 pass on formatting & coherency. 3 samples show truncated tokens at the end (likely kvcache timing).

Tom: Given the metrics + small formatting blips, recommend setting an explicit holdcall: rollback threshold = 5xx > 0.6% over 10m OR 95p latency > 300ms over 5m. If hit, revert eu-west to v3.2.0 and pause rollout.

Maya: Ok issuing holdcall. deploy-bot: pause traffic shift for cny-3151.

deploy-bot: Traffic shift paused for cny-3151 at 5% (requested by Maya). Canary state: PAUSED.

Oliver: Opening a quick infra PSR. I'll attempt to cordon/drain the noisy node and rebalance replicas in eu-west.

Kai: Confirmed: node-gpu-12 had a stuck worker causing elevated GPU mem. Killed the worker and restarted replica; kvcache evictions spike subsiding.

sre-bot: Metrics update: eu-west 95p latency now +2% over baseline; GPU mem stable at ~68%. No elevated 5xx.

Jess: Re-ran smoke-chat on a fresh sample: 50/50 OK, one tiny prompt edge-case but not user-impacting.

Maya: Good. Consensus check: proceed to 20% in 15m if no regressions. If we see any regressions, we revert regionally to v3.2.0 and pause. Who will hit the next step?

Oliver: I'll initiate the step to 20% at +15m and stay on it. If anything looks off I'll pin eu-west back to v3.2.0 and notify here.

Tom: Ping me 5m before stepping to 20% and again at +2m into the step. I'll monitor SLOs and be ready to abort.

Maya: Sounds good. Release note reminder: add blurb 'v3.2.1 batching improvements; watch kvcache memory in eu-west during early rollout.'

Oliver: Ack. I'll also add a short ops note to the incident: 'lightswitch canary — temporary hold due to GPU mem spike; recovered, stepping to 20% in 15m.'

Maya: Thanks all. If deploy-bot can schedule the step and send an automated preflight 5m-warning, that would be ideal. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled: step to 20% at ts+900s. Will post preflight warnings at ts+600s and ts+840s.

Jess: I'll keep running rolling smoke evals during the next ramp.

Kai: I'll keep monitoring kvcache and node mem trends.

sre-bot: Standby monitoring active. No ongoing alerts.

Maya: Great. Everyone stay on call for the step window — we can abort fast if thresholds cross. Thanks!
